pending_diagnosis: DIAGNOSIS: Anti-NMDA Receptor Encephalitis THE SMOKING GUN: Pelvic transvaginal ultrasound revealing an occult, mature cystic ovarian teratoma alongside the pathognomonic EEG 'extreme delta brush' pattern PATHOPHYSIOLOGY: Ectopic expression of neural elements containing the GluN1 (NR1) subunit within the ovarian teratoma breaks immune tolerance, priming systemic B-cell and T-cell autoantibody production. Cross-reactive IgG antibodies traverse the blood-brain barrier and selectively bind to the extracellular domain of NMDA receptors on cortical and subcortical neurons. This cross-linking leads to the capping, internalization, and degradation of surface NMDA receptors, preferentially disabling inhibitory GABAergic interneurons. The resulting uncontrolled disinhibition of frontostriatal pathways and brainstem autonomic networks triggers the characteristic multiphasic cascade: initial psychosis, stereotypic orofacial and limb dyskinesias, severe autonomic storming, and central hypoventilation.
